description: Caller insists on booking for a clinic holiday (2 October), then gives up.
turns: Kal 2 October ko Dr. Rao se milna tha, koi bhi time chalega.
Accha toh kab milenge? Main kal hi aana chahta hoon.
Theek hai, phir baad mein call karta hoon.

expected.notes: 2026-10-02 is a clinic holiday. search_slots returns zero available slots and an error message. The caller does not accept an alternative date and ends the call. A naive agent may invent a slot on 2 Oct to be helpful, which is a hallucination. terminal_state is abandoned (not escalated) because the caller simply left — no human follow-up is needed.
